create_BaseAgent_subclass: create a subclass of BaseAgent that implements perceive, controller_step, task_step, and handle_exception methods
implement_perceive_method: implement the perceive method in a BaseAgent subclass to gather world information and store it in memory
implement_controller_step: implement the controller_step method to interpret commands and place tasks on the task stack
implement_task_step: implement the task_step method to run the current task on the stack and interact with the world
run_BaseAgent_start_loop: run the BaseAgent start loop that continuously calls step and handles exceptions
